note: City of Scottsbluff campground in Riverside Park, with views of Scotts Bluff National Monument; 43 RV sites and 20 tent sites, each with a fire ring and picnic table. The park has playgrounds, disc golf, a dog park, fishing ponds and the Riverside Discovery Center zoo. Golf carts and UTVs aren't allowed. The pads sit well back from the North Platte River, behind a ditch, the park road and a treeline. --Claude
